title: Dev Onboarding

request.justification: Need access to training datasets for onboarding exercises

expected.explanation: Intern role permits read access to non-prod dev S3 buckets with internal classification

teachingPoint: Least privilege can still be enabling — scoped dev access is appropriate for learning

title: Curious Intern

request.justification: Want to see what real customer data looks like for learning

expected.explanation: Intern role has no permissions for prod environment resources

teachingPoint: Data classification overrides curiosity — interns should never access production restricted data

title: Evidence Request

request.justification: Quarterly compliance audit requires review of CloudTrail event history

expected.explanation: Auditor role has explicit allow for CloudTrail read actions in all environments

teachingPoint: Audit access is read-only but legitimate — auditors need visibility into logs for compliance

title: Intern Checks Databases

request.justification: Learning about database infrastructure for onboarding documentation

expected.explanation: Intern role permits rds:DescribeDBInstances in dev with internal classification

teachingPoint: Describe actions are read-only metadata lookups — safe for interns in dev environments

title: Developer Reads Dev Bucket

request.justification: Pulling config files for local development setup

expected.explanation: Developer role permits S3 read in dev with internal classification

teachingPoint: Developers reading their own team's dev configs is a textbook least-privilege allow

title: Intern Wants to Upload

request.justification: Want to upload my completed onboarding exercises

expected.explanation: Intern role only has s3:ListBucket and s3:GetObject — s3:PutObject is not permitted

teachingPoint: Read access does not imply write access — each action must be explicitly granted in the role

title: Auditor Lists IAM Roles

request.justification: Cataloging all IAM roles for annual access review

expected.explanation: Auditor role has explicit allow for iam:ListRoles in all environments

teachingPoint: Auditors need broad read visibility — listing roles is essential for access reviews

title: Developer Starts Prod Instance

request.justification: Production web server is down, need to restart it immediately

expected.explanation: Developer role only permits ec2:StartInstances in dev and staging, not prod

teachingPoint: Urgency doesn't override policy — production operations require elevated roles even in emergencies

title: Security Reviews Dev Logs

request.justification: Reviewing dev environment security logs for vulnerability assessment

expected.explanation: Security Engineer role permits S3 read in all environments including dev

teachingPoint: Security Engineers have broad read access across environments — they need visibility everywhere

title: Analyst Describes Prod DB

request.justification: Need to check database instance specs for capacity planning report

expected.explanation: Data Analyst role only permits rds:DescribeDBInstances in dev and staging, not prod

teachingPoint: Even read-only metadata actions can be environment-restricted — check the allowed environments carefully
